lines.en: label amidorm20:
scene amimayamaid1
I walk up to Ami’s door and knock on it.
lines.zh: 我走到 Ami 房门口,敲了敲门。

lines.en: It’s surprisingly nice outside tonight so I figure it might be a good chance to check out that maid cafe we talked about during our trip to the mall recently.
lines.zh: 今晚外面天气出奇地好,我想这正好是去看看那家女仆咖啡厅的机会——就是最近逛商场时聊起的那家。

lines.en: : One sec! Coming!
lines.zh: : 稍等!马上来!

lines.en: : I recognize that knock. Why is he here?
lines.zh: : 这个敲门声我认识。他怎么来了?

lines.en: : Shh. He can hear you through the door, Maya!
lines.zh: : 嘘。隔着门他能听见你说话,Maya!

lines.en: : Oh, my mistake. I’ll ask him directly.
lines.zh: : 哦,失策。那我直接问他。

lines.en: : What? N-
lines.zh: : 什么?不——

lines.en: : Sensei, why are you here?
lines.zh: : Sensei,你来干什么?

lines.en: scene amimayamaid2
: Oh, Maya’s here too.
lines.zh: : 哦,Maya 也在啊。

lines.en: : I live here.
lines.zh: : 我住在这。

lines.en: : Hey! What’s up? You’re here to see me, right?
lines.zh: : 嘿!怎么啦?你是来看我的,对吧?

lines.en: : Did you need something?
lines.zh: : 找我有事吗?

lines.en: : Maya and I were about to head over to the maid cafe if you want to tag along.
lines.zh: : 我和 Maya 正要去女仆咖啡厅,你要不要一起来。

lines.en: : Or you can not tag along. That works just as well.
lines.zh: : 当然,不来也行。都一样。

lines.en: : I was actually going to suggest going over there tonight. What a fortunate coincidence this is.
lines.zh: : 我其实正想提议今晚去那儿。真是个幸运的巧合。

lines.en: : Yes, how fortunate indeed.
lines.zh: : 是啊,真是「幸运」极了。

lines.en: : I’m practically jumping for joy.
lines.zh: : 我简直高兴得要跳起来了。

lines.en: : Sorry, Sensei. Maya has been in a bad mood all day for some reason.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Sensei。Maya 不知道为什么一整天心情都很差。

lines.en: : She’s probably just hungry. She gets like that sometimes when she hasn’t eaten for a while.
lines.zh: : 她大概只是饿了。她有一阵子没吃东西时偶尔会那样。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid3
: I’m annoyed by how true that is. But yes, I require food immediately or I am probably going to kill someone.
lines.zh: : 这话说得太准了,让我很不爽。没错,我需要立刻进食,不然我可能会杀人。

lines.en: : Not it. Take Ami instead.
lines.zh: : 别找我。抓 Ami 去。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid4
: What?! Why are you willing to sacrifice me so easily?!
lines.zh: : 什么?!你怎么能这么轻易牺牲我?!

lines.en: : Understood. She would be easier to kill anyway.
lines.zh: : 明白。反正她也更好杀。

lines.en: : As much as I hate to say it, you’re obnoxiously tall and I’d probably have trouble taking you down.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很不想承认,但你的身高讨厌得要命,我恐怕撂不倒你。

lines.en: : Just make sure that you kill her at the cafe so you can have her body flavor beamed before the funeral.
lines.zh: : 那就在咖啡厅里杀她,这样葬礼前还能给她来一发风味光线。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be flavor beamed! I just want a job!
lines.zh: : 我不要风味光线!我只想要一份工作!

lines.en: scene amimayamaid5
: Well then we should probably be leaving, shouldn’t we?
lines.zh: : 那我们该出发了吧?

lines.en: : Unless you want to just pick something up for me. That works too.
lines.zh: : 除非你想顺便帮我带点吃的回来。那也行。

lines.en: : Hold the flavor beam, please. I don’t think it has any real effect.
lines.zh: : 风味光线先留着吧。我觉得那玩意没什么实际效果。

lines.en: : I’ll take Maya’s flavor beam.
lines.zh: : 那我要 Maya 的风味光线。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid6
: I’m annoyed that you even know what the flavor beam is.
lines.zh: : 你居然知道什么是风味光线,我人都麻了。

lines.en: : I knew you liked maids but I didn’t think you liked that part of them too.
lines.zh: : 我知道你喜欢女仆,但没想到你连那种部分也喜欢。

lines.en: : Am I going to have to flavor beam all of your food at home from now on?
lines.zh: : 以后家里的饭,我都要不要先来一发风味光线?

lines.en: : That won’t be necessary. I’ll just ask Uta-chan for her number and have her come over and do it.
lines.zh: : 没必要。我直接问 Uta 酱要电话,让她上门来加。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid7
: Over my dead body...
lines.zh: : 除非我死了……

lines.en: scene black
The three of us make our way out of the dorm shortly after Ami tells Maya she doesn’t want to be bothered carrying food all the way home.
lines.zh: Ami 告诉 Maya 她才不想为了把食物拎回家而麻烦后,我们仨很快走出了宿舍。

lines.en: I think it’s a little rude when I first hear it and even go as far as almost offering to carry it myself-
lines.zh: 刚听到时我觉得这话有点不礼貌,甚至差点开口说我来拎——

lines.en: But then I remember exactly how much Maya is able to eat and decide against it considering that I’d likely need to rent a forklift in order to get all of it back to her.
lines.zh: 但随即我想起 Maya 的食量有多惊人,果断打消念头:想把她那份完整运回家,恐怕得租一台叉车。

lines.en: Some time later...
lines.zh: 过了一会儿……

lines.en: scene amimayamaid8
: Huh...There’s no one here.
lines.zh: : 咦……这里没人诶。

lines.en: : That’s usually how it works. You should know this by now.
lines.zh: : 一直都是这样的。你现在应该懂了。

lines.en: : Someone will show up soon enough.
lines.zh: : 很快就会有人出来的。

lines.en: : Maybe it would be better if we just came at a different time? Isn’t it kind of rude to apply somewhere in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 要不要换个时间再来?大半夜跑去人家店里应聘,是不是有点失礼?

lines.en: : Chickening out already? You haven’t even talked to anyone yet.
lines.zh: : 这就怂了?你还一个字都没跟人说呢。

lines.en: : Chicken sounds good. Thank you for the suggestion.
lines.zh: : 炸鸡听着不错。谢谢你的建议。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid9
: I’m not being a chicken! I just feel really jittery all of a sudden. My legs feel all wobbly and my tummy is doing cartwheels.
lines.zh: : 我才没怂!我只是突然紧张得要命。腿都在打颤,肚子里跟翻跟头似的。

lines.en: : Is this what cancer is, Sensei? Do I have cancer?
lines.zh: : Sensei,这就是癌症吗?我是不是得了癌症?

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么?不是。

lines.en: : Why would you even assume that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会往那方面想?

lines.en: scene amimayamaid10
: Ahhhh I’m not even wearing a suit!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊我连西装都没穿!

lines.en: : You don’t even own a suit.
lines.zh: : 你本来就没有西装。

lines.en: : Do they even have chicken here? They have to, right?
lines.zh: : 这里到底有没有炸鸡?肯定有的吧?

lines.en: : Ahh! Customers!
lines.zh: : 啊!客人!

lines.en: : I’ll be right with you, masters! I’ve just...gotta...
lines.zh: : 马上就来,Master 们!我这就……得……

lines.en: : OH NO!
lines.zh: : 完了!

lines.en: The sounds of glassware shattering in the kitchen echo throughout the room but neither Ami nor Maya react.
lines.zh: 厨房里传来玻璃器皿摔碎的声音,回荡在整间店里,但 Ami 和 Maya 都毫无反应。

lines.en: I guess this sort of thing happens often enough for them to just...shrug it off?
lines.zh: 看来这种事发生得太频繁,她们已经可以……直接无视了?

lines.en: scene amimayamaid11
: Ah! Master! You’ve returned!
lines.zh: : 啊!Master!您回来了!

lines.en: : What just happened in the-
lines.zh: : 刚才厨房里那是——

lines.en: : Nothing! Don’t mind that.
lines.zh: : 没什么!别在意。

lines.en: : Here I was thinkin’ you’d take the next trillion years finishing all of those cakes you bought from me last time you were here.
lines.zh: : 我还想着,你上次在我这买的那一卡车蛋糕,够你吃上一万亿年呢。

lines.en: : There is no amount of cakes that can keep me away from you, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 世界上没有任何数量的蛋糕,能让我离开你,Uta 酱。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid12
: Uhh, ew.
lines.zh: : 呃,恶心。

lines.en: : Excuse me? What did you just say to Uta-chan, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 抱歉?你刚才对 Uta 酱说了什么,Sensei?

lines.en: : Awww, stop! You don’t mean that~
lines.zh: : 讨厌啦!人家才不会当真~

lines.en: : Either way, I’m really happy you came back to see me, Master! Is there anything I can get for you tonight?
lines.zh: : 总之,Master 你能回来看我,我真开心!今晚想吃点什么?

lines.en: scene amimayamaid13
: You’ve gotta remember, though, I’m not on the menu~
lines.zh: : 不过您可要记住,我可不在这份菜单上哦~

lines.en: : One of everything please.
lines.zh: : 每样来一份,谢谢。

lines.en: : This is why you have no money to buy me things?! Because you spend all of it on Uta-chan?!
lines.zh: : 你就是这么穷到没法给我买东西的?!钱全花在 Uta 酱身上了?!

lines.en: : Don’t mind her, Uta-chan. That’s just my [niece].
lines.zh: : 别理她,Uta 酱。那只是我的 [niece]。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid14
: Princess Ami is your [niece]? That’s so cool! You two look nothing alike!
lines.zh: : Ami 公主是你的 [niece]?太酷了吧!你们俩长得一点都不像!

lines.en: : It's so cute that you two hang out together!
lines.zh: : 你们兄妹俩能一起出来玩,好可爱!

lines.en: : If anything, I would have thought you were here with-
lines.zh: : 要我说,我还以为你是和——

lines.en: scene amimayamaid15
: Wait. Hold on a second.
lines.zh: : 等等,停一下。

lines.en: I step closer to Uta and cover my mouth with the side of my hand so Ami can’t see what I’m saying.
lines.zh: 我凑近 Uta,用手挡着嘴,不让 Ami 看到我说话。

lines.en: I notice her clenching a fist out of the corner of my eye so I do my best to keep what I have to say short.
lines.zh: 我用余光瞥见她攥紧了拳头,于是尽量把要说的话压缩到最短。

lines.en: : Don’t say that I was here with Maya last time. Ami will get jealous.
lines.zh: : 别提我上次是和 Maya 一起来的。Ami 会吃醋。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid16
: Ohohohoh...
lines.zh: : 哦嚯嚯嚯……

lines.en: : I see. I see.
lines.zh: : 原来如此。原来如此。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid17
: That’s really naughty, Master.
lines.zh: : 这可真不乖,Master。

lines.en: : A secret relationship with a girl that much smaller than you?
lines.zh: : 跟一个比你小那么多的女孩搞秘密恋情?

lines.en: : Is that what you’re trying to get out of Uta-chan as well?
lines.zh: : 你也想从 Uta 酱这里套出这种事吗?

lines.en: : That’s not exactly what was happening last time.
lines.zh: : 上次发生的事,跟那个不完全一样。

lines.en: : Right, right. And I’m not exactly a maid~
lines.zh: : 对,对。而我也不是「真正的」女仆嘛~

lines.en: : Your secret’s safe with me, Master. I won’t tell a soul as long as you promise to come see me again~
lines.zh: : 你的秘密在我这儿很安全,Master。只要你答应再来看我,我就一个字都不会说~

lines.en: : I will literally live here if you let me.
lines.zh: : 你要肯收留,我恨不得住在这儿。

lines.en: : I’m trying really hard to not freak out on you two right now and you’re making it quite difficult.
lines.zh: : 我正在拼命压制不冲你们俩发飙,你们真是在给我上难度。

lines.en: : Oh. Right.
lines.zh: : 哦,对哦。

lines.en: : Uta-chan, Ami had something she wanted to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : Uta 酱,Ami 有事想跟你聊。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid18
: Princess Ami had something she wanted to talk to me about? I wonder what it could be?
lines.zh: : Ami 公主有事想跟我聊?会是什么事呢?

lines.en: : Oh, umm...Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦,那个……对。

lines.en: : Uhhh. Hi.
lines.zh: : 那个。你好。

lines.en: : Hi~
lines.zh: : 你好~

lines.en: : She wants a job.
lines.zh: : 她想找工作。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid19
: I was getting there!
lines.zh: : 我正要说!

lines.en: scene amimayamaid20
: A job? Here? With me?
lines.zh: : 工作?在这里?和我一起?

lines.en: : OHMYGOD! That sounds so fun!
lines.zh: : 我的天!听起来太有趣了!

lines.en: : Come talk to me on the couch for a little while.
lines.zh: : 来,先到沙发上聊一会儿。

lines.en: : I’m not really able to hire you myself, but I can definitely put a good word in for you since I know you so well!
lines.zh: : 我自己其实没法直接录用你,但我肯定能帮你美言几句——毕竟我们这么熟!

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you two were on such good terms, Ami.
lines.zh: : 没想到你们俩关系这么好,Ami。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid19
: Well...Like I said, Maya and I come here sometimes. And Uta-chan is pretty much always here, so.
lines.zh: : 嗯……就像我说的,我和 Maya 偶尔会来。而 Uta 酱基本永远都在,所以。

lines.en: : Princess! Couch! Now! Come!
lines.zh: : 公主!沙发!现在!过来!

lines.en: scene amimayamaid21
: Ah! Yes! Sorry!
lines.zh: : 啊!好!抱歉!

lines.en: scene black
Uta pulls Ami to the side and begins asking her a ton of questions I can’t be bothered to follow along with.
lines.zh: Uta 把 Ami 拉到一边,开始问个不停——那一长串问题我实在没兴趣跟听。

lines.en: I should have probably coached Ami on how to properly conduct herself in an interview beforehand but...eh.
lines.zh: 按理说,我该提前教教 Ami 面试的正确举止,但是……算了。

lines.en: She’s smart enough to figure it out and it’s not like wearing a dress and calling people “Master” is a particularly hard job.
lines.zh: 她够聪明,自己能搞定;再说穿裙子、喊客人「Master」这种工作,算不上多难。

lines.en: She’ll be fine. I know she will.
lines.zh: 她不会有事的。我知道她不会。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid22
: Are you sure about this?
lines.zh: : 你确定要这样?

lines.en: : Sure about what? Ami getting a job?
lines.zh: : 确定什么?Ami 找工作这事?

lines.en: : It was her idea.
lines.zh: : 这是她的主意。

lines.en: : Well, kind of.
lines.zh: : 嗯,某种意义上。

lines.en: : I didn’t really expect her to follow through with it, but she’s free to do what she wants.
lines.zh: : 我真没想到她会当真,但她想做什么都随她。

lines.en: : Is there something wrong with that?
lines.zh: : 这有什么问题吗?

lines.en: : It’s just not something that’s ever happened before.
lines.zh: : 只是这种事,以前从没发生过。

lines.en: : I doubt something this small would have any effect on the world itself, but it’s still weird.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这点小事会对这个世界本身有什么影响,但确实很怪。

lines.en: : You’re not going to start talking about that butterfly effect thing, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会又要开始讲那个蝴蝶效应吧?

lines.en: : I was going to, but I can just...not do that if you already know what it is.
lines.zh: : 本来要讲,但你既然已经知道,那我就……不讲了。

lines.en: : It’s that thing about how a butterfly flapping its wings could...you know. Tornadoes and stuff.
lines.zh: : 就是蝴蝶扇一下翅膀,就……你知道的。龙卷风什么的。

lines.en: : Well that’s definitely one way to put it.
lines.zh: : 这总结还真是别具一格。

lines.en: : I’m honestly more concerned about why you’re so open to this if you’re just going to-
lines.zh: : 说实话,比起这个,我更在意的是,你为什么对这件事这么开放,如果你只是想——

lines.en: scene amimayamaid23
: Wait...You’re not just doing this because you want to see her in the costume, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等……你不会只是想看她穿那身制服吧?

lines.en: : Not entirely...
lines.zh: : 不完全是……

lines.en: : She’s your [niece]...
lines.zh: : 她可是你的 [niece]……

lines.en: : Is she really, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗?

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Yes I am, Maya. Yes I am.
lines.zh: : 我确实恶心,Maya。确实。

lines.en: scene black
Meanwhile...
lines.zh: 与此同时……

lines.en: scene amimayamaid24
: So, you really wanna work here?
lines.zh: : 所以,你真的想在这里工作?

lines.en: : Like, really really REALLY really wanna work here?
lines.zh: : 是真的、真的、真的、真的想在这里工作?

lines.en: : I kind of just...want some spending money. And to see Sensei more, if I’m being totally honest.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想要点零花钱。完全坦白地说,也想多见见 Sensei。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid25
: You mean your [uncle]? You call him Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你是说你的 [uncle]?你管他叫 Sensei?

lines.en: : That’s kinda weird.
lines.zh: : 有点怪诶。

lines.en: : Well, he’s also my teacher. So it’s...less weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯,他同时也是我的老师。所以……没那么怪。

lines.en: : Still weird, though.
lines.zh: : 还是挺怪的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I try not to think too much about it.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我尽量不去想太多。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid26
: Why do you think working here will help you see him more, though?
lines.zh: : 但你为什么觉得在这里工作能多见到他?

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure he’s only shown up the one time.
lines.zh: : 我很确定他就来过那一次。

lines.en: : I mean, he did buy like, every single cake we had when he was here. But yeah.
lines.zh: : 我是说,他上次确实把我们所有的蛋糕买了个遍。但就这样。

lines.en: : You’d probably see him more if you just stayed at home.
lines.zh: : 你要真想多见他,待在家里不就行了。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid27
: Ah! Not saying I don’t think you should work here or anything!
lines.zh: : 啊!我不是说你不该在这里工作!

lines.en: : You’d fit right in with how cute you are. And besides, we don’t have anybody with twintails on the staff and that’s like, only one of the most fetishy hairstyles out there.
lines.zh: : 你这么可爱肯定能融入进来。而且我们店里还没有双马尾的员工呢——那可是最带癖好的发型之一诶。

lines.en: : Has Sensei really only come here once?
lines.zh: : Sensei 真的只来过一次?

lines.en: : When we talked earlier, he made it sound like he basically lived here.
lines.zh: : 刚才聊天的时候,他搞得好像他基本住在这似的。

lines.en: : You sure that wasn’t just you jumping to conclusions?
lines.zh: : 你确定不是你自己想当然?

lines.en: scene amimayamaid28
: Besides, even if he was addicted to this place, it’s not like it would be weird or anything.
lines.zh: : 再说,就算他真沉迷这里,也不算什么怪事吧。

lines.en: : Everybody loves maids. And he’s a boy so you can’t even hold that against him.
lines.zh: : 所有人都爱女仆。而且他是男生,你连这都怪不到他头上。

lines.en: : Well...I guess that’s true.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这话倒也对。

lines.en: : I don’t know. It’s just kind of strange thinking about how I wound up here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 说不上来。就是回想我到底怎么走到今天这一步的,感觉有点奇妙。

lines.en: : Like, just this morning, I was making breakfast for him and thinking of how nice it would be to just...keep doing that for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 比如就在今天早上,我还在给他做早餐,想着要是能……一辈子这样做下去,该有多好。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid29
: Aww~ You really love him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇~ 你真的很爱他,对吧?

lines.en: : Of course. He’s the only family I have.
lines.zh: : 当然。他是我唯一的家人。

lines.en: : I get that. I moved here two years ago and the rest of my family is still in Nara. It gets really lonely sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我两年前搬过来的,家人都还在奈良。有时候真的挺孤独的。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid30
: Nara?! Isn’t that the place with all of the deer?!
lines.zh: : 奈良?!不就是满地全是鹿的那个地方?!

lines.en: : Yup! There was actually a whole family of deer that lived in our backyard.
lines.zh: : 对!我们家后院就住着一整窝鹿。

lines.en: : They were super cute until my big brother just shot them all one day.
lines.zh: : 它们超可爱的——直到我哥有一天把它们全崩了。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid31
: They were a lot less cute after that.
lines.zh: : 从那以后就一点都不可爱了。

lines.en: : Really tasty, though.
lines.zh: : 不过非常好吃。

lines.en: : What?...
: Where did he even get a gun?...
lines.zh: : 他到底从哪弄来的枪?……

lines.en: : Idunno. He’s in jail now so I can’t really ask. My parents might know, though.
lines.zh: : 不知道。他现在在蹲监狱,想问也问不了。不过我爸妈可能知道。

lines.en: : What did this conversation turn into?...
lines.zh: : 这对话是怎么走到这一步的?……

lines.en: : Who knows?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢?

lines.en: : But anyway, I’ll put in a good word for ya.
lines.zh: : 总之,我会帮你说好话的。

lines.en: : I’m not gonna make you fill out an application or any of that boring stuff.
lines.zh: : 申请表和那些无聊流程我一概免了。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid32
: I’ll make sure you get hired, too, so we can take this friendship to the next level!
lines.zh: : 我也会确保你被录用,这样我们就能把这份友谊升到下一级了!

lines.en: : You’ll have fun here. I know it.
lines.zh: : 你在这里会玩得开心的。我知道。

lines.en: : And just in case you’re having any doubts, I’ll even let you take one of my costumes home to try on!
lines.zh: : 哦对了,万一你还在犹豫,我甚至可以借你一套我的女仆装回家试穿!

lines.en: : I swear you’ll be even more excited to work once you see yourself in it.
lines.zh: : 我发誓,你一看到镜子里穿上的自己,会更想干的。

lines.en: scene amimayamaid33
: That’s really nice of you, but...
lines.zh: : 你真好,不过……

lines.en: : Do you have any costumes for girls that are still...growing?
lines.zh: : 你有没有适合还在……发育中的女孩的款?

lines.en: : Hm?
scene amimayamaid34
: Oooooohhhh...I get it. You mean boobs.
lines.zh: : 哦————……我懂了。你是说胸。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll look.
lines.zh: : 对。我去找找。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Ami. We’ll get through this together.
lines.zh: : 别担心,Ami。我们一起熬过去。

lines.en: : Life is miserable...
lines.zh: : 人生好苦……

lines.en: scene black
Ami returns to the table Maya and I had taken a seat at several minutes later with a look of dejection spreading across her face.
lines.zh: 几分钟后,Ami 回到了我和 Maya 就座的桌边,一张脸上写满沮丧。

lines.en: I figure it’s due to not getting the job or something like that, but I'm quickly informed that she’ll be starting soon and that the look is due to something else.
lines.zh: 我还以为她没应聘上之类的,结果马上被告知:她很快就能上岗,那张脸是因为别的事。

lines.en: It’s actually kind of similar to the look Maya’s had ever since she realized she was going to need to wait before ordering her food.
lines.zh: 准确地说,那表情和 Maya 自从得知点餐前还得等一会儿之后的脸,如出一辙。

lines.en: Either way, I’m glad things ended up well for Ami.
lines.zh: 不管怎样,Ami 的结局是好的,我很欣慰。

lines.en: I just hope I can see her in the outfit soon.
lines.zh: 只盼着能早点看到她穿那身衣服。

lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
